decisions.reason: The firm has sustained public commitment and sunk investments in the encrypted secondary channel, and disappointing results can still be attributed to temporary market conditions.
As a central building block of the announced secure ecosystem, its high sunk costs and strategic visibility make withdrawal unlikely despite any shortfall.
The hardware token remains close to existing competencies and has been publicly offered, so management will likely justify continued investment rather than drop it.
Given the public commitment to compliance solutions and accumulated development costs, the firm will persist with this product within the coming year.
